name: consumer_social
description: Consumer social network — challenging category with high CAC.
pitch_summary: Reelay is a new social network focused on authentic connections between college students. Unlike Instagram, we don't allow filters or editing — only raw, unedited moments. We launched 4 months ago and have 12,500 monthly active users, with a 38% day-30 retention rate. We've raised $400k from a combination of angels and one institutional fund.
